query:
BEGIN READ ONLY;
WITH sample AS (
 SELECT o.node_id FROM kg_nodes o
 JOIN kg_edges e ON e.source_node_id=o.node_id AND e.edge_type='CAUSES' AND e.is_active=TRUE
 JOIN kg_nodes f ON f.node_id=e.target_node_id AND f.node_type='Fault' AND f.is_active=TRUE
 WHERE o.node_type='Observable' AND o.is_active=TRUE ORDER BY o.node_id LIMIT 1
), cases AS (
 SELECT 'absent' AS case_name, NULL::integer AS km, '[]'::jsonb AS history,
 NULL::text AS phase, NULL::text AS temp, NULL::text AS speed
 UNION ALL SELECT 'declared', 0, '[{"operation_slug":"oil_change","last_service_km":0}]'::jsonb, 'demarrage','froid','0_30'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'unconstrained_raw', NULL, '[]'::jsonb, 'any','any','any'
)
SELECT c.case_name, s.node_id AS observable_id, COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d) ORDER BY d.fault_id) FILTER (WHERE d.fault_id IS NOT NULL),'[]'::jsonb) AS faults
FROM sample s CROSS JOIN cases c
LEFT JOIN LATERAL kg_diagnose_with_explainable_score(ARRAY[s.node_id],NULL,NULL,c.km,c.history,c.phase,c.temp,c.speed,10) d ON TRUE
GROUP BY c.case_name,s.node_id ORDER BY c.case_name;
COMMIT;
